No. 2027/11 – TUESDAY, JULY 11, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: BD/UP/LND.1/UO/1/10/4. Land Ministry No.: 4-3/9/2013/IR/59.
I, hereby notice, under the Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land to be acquired:

Eighteen (18) Allotments of Lots in total extent of about 0.9763 Hectare shown as Lot No. 357 to 394, depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. FVP 48, Sheet No. 6, supplement 16, Dated 14.03.2017 prepared by the Surveyor-General situated in the village of Kotawera Udagama in Kotawera Udagama Grama Niladari Division (53E) of DehivinipalathaKorale minor division, in Divisional Secretary’s Division, of Uvaparanagama in the District of Badulla in Uva Province, More fully Described below;
01. Lot No. 423 Name of Land: Kurudugasella; Description: Garden; Claimant: Mrs. Disanayaka Mudiyanselage Gnanawathi, resident of : A-08, Umanadi, Moragolla, Welimada, Land Extent: 0.0071 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 428 Name of Land: Kurudugasella; Description: Garden; Claimant: Mrs. Disanayaka Mudiyanselage Gnanawathi,
resident of : A-08, Umanadi, Moragolla, Welimada, Land Extent: 0.2951 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 429 Name of Land: Kurudugasella; Description: Garden; Claimant: Mrs. Disanayaka Mudiyanselage Gnanawathi, resident of; A08, Umanadi, Moragolla, Welimada,Land Extent: 0.2023 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 430 Name of Land: Kurudugasella; Description: Drain, Reserved land for Dulgolla river and Morethota Canal; Claimant: Government; Land Extent: 0.0081 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 432 Name of Land: Kurudugasella; Description: Garden; Claimant: Mr. Herath Mudiyanselage Sunil Herath Bandara, resident of Thalahena, Ehala Kotawera, Welimada; Land Extent: 0.1073 Hectare.
06. Lot No. 433 Name of Land: Kurudugasella; Description: Ladukela, Reserved land for Dulgolla river and Morethota Canal; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0345 Hectare.

07. Lot No. 435 Name of Land: Bogahaarawa; Description: Homegarden; Claimant: Ratnayaka Mudiyanselage Karunasena, resident of C-05, Umanadi, Moragolla, Welimada and Ratnayaka Mudiyanselage Kusumawathe, resident of C-04, Umanadi, Moragolla, Welimada; Extent: 0.1603 Hectare.
